notes:
Direct HTTP fetch worked, no WAF/robots block. Guessed handle /collections/sale -> 301 redirects to /collections/outlet, confirming the site treats its markdown listing as permanent Outlet/Clearance merchandising, not a temporary 'sale' campaign. Opened /collections/outlet: og:title and on-page H1 both read 'Outlet & Clearance' - the site's OWN taxonomy explicitly names this Clearance, satisfying the brief's Clearance-vs-Sale test outright (no ambiguity flag needed). This page is also a real linked mega-menu group (aria-label='Outlet & Clearance', menu-text-modal-shop nav item) with a genuine 'View All' + 2 sub-category tiles rendered inside that same nav dropdown: 'Furniture & Lighting Outlet' (/collections/outlet-furniture) and 'Accessories Outlet' (/collections/accessories-outlet) - confirmed these are true site-exposed children (found the exact menu HTML block: '...href="/collections/outlet" aria-label="Outlet & Clearance"' followed immediately by 'View All' -> outlet, then the two named children), not incidental footer links, so emitted as parent+children per the shared engine's grouping rule. IMPORTANT qty-inflation trap (matches prior Home-Decor pass's known site defect): the outlet.json 'products_count' field reports 311, and accessories-outlet.json reports 843 - both wildly inflated vs the real listing. Used the same two independent checks the prior pass validated: (1) the collection page's own rendered '<N> items' ProductCountDesktop widget (Alpine.js, server-rendered) and (2) paging /collections/<handle>/products.json?limit=250 and deduping by product id. Both methods agreed exactly for all three URLs: outlet=95, outlet-furniture=36, accessories-outlet=51 (children don't have to sum to the parent's 95 - that's expected, some outlet items may not be tagged into either furniture or accessories sub-collections). Also checked and explicitly excluded as NOT clearance: /collections/in-stock-furniture (146) and /collections/in-stock-sofas (9) - these mean 'ready to ship now', not markdown/outlet stock, no clearance signal in title or description. No other Clearance/Outlet/Final-Sale/Last-Chance/End-of-Line handle found in the 122-URL collections sitemap.
